name: A Thousand Cuts
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach the prevention window from the other chair. Personal Evolution dealing net damage, giving tags and trashing programs — Snare!, Urtica Cipher, Neurospike, Public Trail, Retribution, Ansel 1.0, Ballista, and Vantage Point's Vicsek, ice of none of the three types that turns tags into more tags. Eternal-legal only. Vantage Point Stage 3b: The Red Room for PAD Campaign, Lotus Haze for Offworld Office. Vantage Point Stage 4a: two ezaM for two Tithe. Vantage Point Stage 4b: two Lionsmane for two Public Trail. Vantage Point Stage 6a: two Knowledge Seeker for two Palisade, two Esca for two Regolith Mining License, two Cultivate for two Retribution. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 5b: two Cloud Eater for the Tithe and the Ballista.
